page.overview:
What is Ash?

Ash is the continent on the east of Valisthea in Final Fantasy XVI. Together with the larger continent of Storm, the two are commonly known as "the Twins", a synonym for Valisthea. Ash is a mountainous region, difficult thus to approach overseas.

The only nation in the modern day Ash is the Kingdom of Waloed, the newest nation on the Twins, established when Barnabas Tharmr arrived from the outer continent to invade Ash. The prior kingdom that Waloed thus took over was the Kingdom of Veldemarke, established in the Year of the Realm 450.

Ash used to have two Mothercrystals, but the southern Drake's Horn no longer stands, and the northern Drake's Spine has been the center of disputes between different groups of people since time immemorial. The Horn may have fallen to the Blight, the ever-advancing erosion of the land that appeared on Ash around 300 years ago, as Drake's Horn fell in the Year of the Realm 350.

Ash is the origin of orcs, a beast tribe much larger and stronger than the Stormian goblins.
